person.name: Darryl Anka
person.summary: Channel for 'Bashar' since 1983 (first UFO sightings 1973: a dark metallic triangular craft seen twice in one week); co-founder of Bashar Communications with April Rochelle; writer/director/producer through his production company Zia Films; earlier career as a film special-effects designer.

books.title: The New Metaphysics
books.description: Early collection of Bashar material published under Anka's name; fan-archived audio titled 'The New Metaphysics' is dated 1987-08-19 on archive.org.

books.title: Bashar: Blueprint for Change - A Message from Our Future
books.publisher: New Solutions Publishing (ISBN 1-56284-113-0); first published December 1, 1990; 302 pages
books.description: Transcripts compiled from channeled sessions of 1986-1989 covering human psychology, planetary evolution, metaphysics and extraterrestrial contact; central theme 'You ARE what you BELIEVE'. Listed as out of print ($25 original price) by the Bashar store.

books.title: Quest for Truth: 100 Insights That Could Change Your Life
books.publisher: Nobul Press (ISBN 0-9656078-1-X); first published December 1, 1997; 244 pages
books.description: Compiles the best material from over 30 self-empowerment seminars plus three Bashar books previously released in Japan; themed sections (abundance, creativity, spirituality, health, relationships) each open with a dialogue followed by audience Q&A. Out of print per the Bashar store.

books.title: Shards of a Shattered Mirror Book I: Cryptic
books.publisher: Kindle edition first published September 28, 2017; 269 pages
books.description: Science-fiction novel set 700 years in the future: thirteen-year-old human-alien hybrid Willa Hillicrissing of Port Dublin, apprenticed to Holly Cotton, begins the Five Levels of Mastery and is called to protect Earth and the Interstellar Alliance from an alien Empire. The Willa story-world also appears in Bashar sessions ('Shards of a Shattered Mirror', 'The Fox', 'Willa and the Winter Spirit').

books.title: The Masters of Limitation: An ET's Observations of Earth
books.publisher: Kindle edition first published May 25, 2020; 88 pages (e-book ISBN 978-1-951985-10-3 per Bashar store, $9.99)
books.description: Bashar's outside perspective on human society and humanity's place in the universe, presented as life-changing information that can alter one's view of reality.

books.title: Shards of a Shattered Mirror Book II: Nocturnal
books.publisher: Kindle edition first published July 10, 2020; 328 pages
books.description: Sequel: Willa enters the Second Level of Mastery to become a Nocturnal under Selene Nymphaea, faces assassination attempts by her nemesis Xanthes, and is shown two probable futures for the Alliance.

books.title: Making Contact: Preparing for the New Realities of Extraterrestrial Existence
books.role: contributor (anthology edited by Alan Steinfeld; other contributors include George Noory)
books.description: Anthology on extraterrestrial contact to which Darryl Anka contributed a chapter.

books.title: The Compass: A Guide for Navigating Your Life's Path
books.description: Short guide by Darryl Anka; the Goodreads listing carries no synopsis beyond the author bio.

books.title: The Formula: The Instruction Manual for Living Your Best Life
books.publisher: BookBaby paperback, publication date 09/07/2024, ISBN 9798350973839, 140 pages, $29.95 (Goodreads lists first published October 31, 2024)
books.description: A compact distillation of metaphysical principles - a unifying framework for comparing metaphysical topics and separating authentic causes from folklore - that, applied daily, is meant to create fulfillment, self-empowerment and alignment with one's purpose. Sold via the Bashar store's book section.

books.title: The Great Awakening: Our Prophesized Transformation and the Attainment of Embodied Enlightenment
books.role: contributor (edited by Mike Dooley; with Matt Kahn, Lyssa Royal Holt, Salvatore Rachele, Sara Landon, Daniel Scranton)
books.description: Mike Dooley invites six channels/authors to address ancient prophecies and the current energetic upheaval, with step-by-step guidance toward self-realization; Darryl Anka is one of the contributors.

books.title: Bashar Paperback series (Japanese: バシャール・ペーパーバック 1-8) and other Japanese-language Bashar titles
books.role: author (channeled material, Japanese translations; translators incl. Sekino Naoyuki)
books.publisher: Japanese editions listed on Goodreads (e.g., Bashāru Pēpā Bakku 1-2 in 2002, 3-8 in 2003; 'Bashar 2006: Soul Blueprint'; 'Shift to the Next Earth')
books.description: Goodreads credits Anka with more than 300,000 book sales in Japan; the author list includes numerous Japanese-language Bashar volumes.

films_and_video.title: First Contact
films_and_video.role: director, writer, producer (with producers Erica Jordan and April Rochelle); Zia Films
films_and_video.description: 95-minute documentary narrated by James Woods: after a close encounter with a UFO, a man becomes a trance channel for an extraterrestrial entity, leading to an investigation of the nature of reality and humanity's place in the cosmos. Alternative title 'Bashar: First Contact'. Streams on Gaia; screened at the 2026 'Bashar in Sedona' event.

films_and_video.title: Dearly Departed
films_and_video.description: Fictional documentary about the afterlife produced by Anka's company Zia Films (per Wikipedia).

films_and_video.title: Tuning In
films_and_video.description: 80-minute documentary directed by David Thomas on spirit channeling; Darryl Anka appears channeling Bashar.

films_and_video.title: Interview with the Extraterrestrial
films_and_video.description: Documentary written and directed by Serena DC (producer Miko Allyn Quinones): 'If you could spend one hour with an extraterrestrial, what would you ask them?' Serena DC meets Darryl Anka; also features Paul Hynek, Sarah Breskman Cosme and Lyssa Royal.

films_and_video.title: Messages from Bashar the Extraterrestrial (Gaia series)
films_and_video.description: Gaia documentary series: 'Where Do We Come From?', 'What Is the Nature of Existence?', 'What Is Our Purpose?', 'How Do We Find Our Path?', 'Are We Alone?', 'Where Are We Headed'. TVDB series 461000 (record created 2025-03-05).

films_and_video.title: Great Minds S2:Ep1 - Darryl Anka: Channeling Bashar (Gaia)
films_and_video.description: 32-minute Gaia interview episode on Anka's 1973 sighting, the mechanics of channeling and the 'highest excitement' formula.

film_industry_credits.title: Special-effects design work (per Wikipedia): Star Trek: The Motion Picture; I, Robot; Pirates of the Caribbean; Live Free or Die Hard; Iron Man
film_industry_credits.description: Wikipedia's Darryl Anka article lists these films among his special-effects design credits, citing IMDb. IMDb and TMDB could not be fetched directly (robots.txt), so individual job titles (e.g., storyboard/model work) are not independently verified here.

audio_and_digital.title: BasharTV (tv.bashar.org / bashartv.com)
audio_and_digital.description: Subscription streaming of 'Bashar channeling sessions from the 1980's to today' with a public sitemap of ~500 program pages; community, playlists, downloadable videos, live-stream tickets; iOS app 'BasharTV' (App Store id6740915343) and Android app (tv.uscreen.bashartv). Intro bundles: Foundation, Activation, Expansion and Integration series.

audio_and_digital.title: Bashar Store (store.bashar.org, formerly basharstore.com)
audio_and_digital.description: Sells books, apparel, crystals, essentials and event-commemorative merchandise (Sedona 2024/2025, Palm Springs 2026, New York 2026, '2027 EveryThing Changes'); session video is sold via BasharTV.

audio_and_digital.title: The Bashar Library Project
audio_and_digital.description: Donation-funded effort to digitize, sound-enhance, transcribe and database (by subject and date) all Bashar material generated since 1983, restore lost sessions and establish a permanent physical archive.

audio_and_digital.title: Session handouts (PDF library)
audio_and_digital.description: 35 downloadable handouts on bashar.org for sessions such as The 33rd Parallel, The 9 Levels of Consciousness, The Black Box, The Formula, The Interstellar Enneagram, The Parallel Reality Wheel, Protocols of First Contact, The Story Tree and You Are All Time Travelers.

audio_and_digital.title: Official channels: YouTube (BasharChanneledbyDarrylAnka), Spotify, Vimeo (basharcommunications), Instagram, TikTok, Facebook
audio_and_digital.description: Links published in the bashar.org footer; the Vimeo profile describes Bashar as 'a multidimensional being channeled by Darryl Anka, sharing cutting edge information on the nature of consciousness, self-empowerment, and how you manifest'.
